reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004AD140 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004AD140-Camera_ResetMatrix_26.cpp at sha256 44665af0127cfccec9cfe87875f6d4f01f9f6d270cf7fd91a63e750d739a68b2 (recorded implementation.signature: uint32_t __stdcall(int32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4) __pure Camera_ResetMatrix_26(void);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Camera_ResetMatrix_26
retail_function.signature: uint32_t __stdcall(int32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4) __pure
retail_function.summary: 11 blocks / 16 edges: if arg4==0 return ((arg2%arg3)<<32 | arg1) / arg3; else normalise arg4/arg3/arg2/arg1 with RRCD doubling, divide COMBINE(edx,eax) by the normalised divisor, then correct the quotient by comparing HIGHD(arg3*result)+result*arg4 with arg2/arg1. Returns the 64-bit quotient in EDX:EAX (the caller at 0x4A7CE4 reads both: `mov esi,eax; mov edi,edx`).

candidate_function.signature: uint32_t __stdcall(int32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4) __pure Camera_ResetMatrix_26(void);
candidate_function.summary: __aulldiv(arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) is a direct lift of the BN pseudocode: the arg4==0 path and the normalised path with RRCD/COMBINE/HIGHD/LOWD all match, but the function is declared `unsigned int` and returns only the low 32 bits.

divergences: Return width: retail returns EDX:EAX (and _output consumes EDX at 0x004A7CEE); the candidate returns a 32-bit value and drops the high half.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x004AD140 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004AD140-Camera_ResetMatrix_26.cpp (sha256 44665af0127cfccec9cfe87875f6d4f01f9f6d270cf7fd91a63e750d739a68b2). 11 blocks / 16 edges: if arg4==0 return ((arg2%arg3)<<32 | arg1) / arg3; else normalise arg4/arg3/arg2/arg1 with RRCD doubling, divide COMBINE(edx,eax) by the normalised divisor, then correct the quotient by comparing HIGHD(arg3*result)+result*arg4 with arg2/arg1. Returns the 64-bit quotient in EDX:EAX (the caller at 0x4A7CE4 reads both: `mov esi,eax; mov edi,edx`). Candidate: __aulldiv(arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4) is a direct lift of the BN pseudocode: the arg4==0 path and the normalised path with RRCD/COMBINE/HIGHD/LOWD all match, but the function is declared `unsigned int` and returns only the low 32 bits.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Retail uses __stdcall with four dwords and `retn 0x10` (BN: `uint32_t __stdcall(int32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)`) which the candidate reproduces; the stack frame and cleanup match.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: arg1/arg2 are the low/high halves of the dividend, arg3/arg4 the low/high halves of the divisor; the candidate's COMBINE(0,arg2)/COMBINE(arg2,arg1) usage matches the retail register mapping.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and radare2 agree on 11 blocks / 16 edges (similarity 1.000); angr CFGFast recovers 11 blocks with has_unresolved_jumps=false.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Leaf function; no calls in either.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: The correction compares HIGHD(arg3*result)+result*arg4 against arg2 and LOWD(arg3*result) against arg1, matching the retail mul/add/cmp sequence.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Only argument words and the return registers are touched.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail returns a 64-bit quotient in EDX:EAX and its caller reads EDX (0x004A7CEE `mov edi,edx`). The candidate is declared `unsigned int` and truncates the 64-bit quotient expression to EAX, leaving EDX undefined; the high half is lost on every fast-path result above 2^32.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "uint32_t __stdcall(int32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4) __pure" at 0x004AD140; radare2 recovers "fcn.004ad140 (int32_t arg_ch, int32_t arg_10h, int32_t arg_14h, int32_t arg_18h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x004AD140 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: uint32_t __stdcall(int32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4) __pure Camera_ResetMatrix_26(void);.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The candidate defines __aulldiv, not the catalog name Camera_ResetMatrix_26.
The retail identity is the MSVC 64-bit unsigned divide helper, not a camera routine; the catalog name is a harvest label.
